y9-11g-q5.question: If \(y = (2a + 3)x - 2\) is parallel to \(y = ax - 5\), find the value of \(a\).
y9-11g-q5.hint: Set the coefficient of \(x\) of both equations equal to each other.
y9-11g-q5.solution:
Gradients of parallel lines are equal:
\(2a + 3 = a \implies a = -3\).
